## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. Concrete is better than abstract - a
real image, mode, or workflow that doesn't work well today beats a general "it would be nice if."

## What would you like to happen?

A clear description of the feature or change you're proposing. If it changes the CLI contract
(new flag, changed default, new mode), say so explicitly - `docs/SPEC.md` is the source of truth
for that contract and would need to change alongside the code.

## Alternatives you've considered

Any other approaches, workarounds, or existing flags that get partway there.

## Additional context

Anything else - links, examples from other tools, mockups, etc.
